## tronsave_get_internal_account

**Internal Account Information** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Retrieve the Tronsave internal account profile for the current logged-in session (wallet/represent address, balances, deposit address). Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when the user needs their linked address or balance. Returns `{ id, balance (SUN string), representAddress, depositAddress }`; any API key in the payload is masked. Read-only.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Internal account id. |
| `balance` | string | Internal balance in SUN as a decimal string (TRX = SUN / 1e6). |
| `representAddress` | string | TRON base58 address that represents (owns) the internal account. |
| `depositAddress` | string | TRON base58 deposit address; send TRX here to top up the internal balance (min 10 TRX). |
| `apiKey` | string | MASKED internal API key; the full key is never returned. |

## tronsave_get_deposit_address

**Get Deposit Address** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Fetches the specific deposit address for the TronSave internal account. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Trigger this tool if the user asks for a deposit address or needs to top up their TronSave TRX balance. Constraints: 1) TRX only; 2) Minimum deposit amount is 10 TRX; 3) Read-only operation.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amountTrx` | number | yes | Amount of TRX the user intends to deposit (minimum 10 TRX). (min 10) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `depositAddress` | string | TRON base58 deposit address; send TRX here to top up the TronSave internal balance. |
| `amountTrx` | number | Amount of TRX the user intends to deposit (echoed back). |
| `minimumDepositTrx` | number | Minimum accepted deposit in TRX. |

## tronsave_internal_order_history

**Internal Account Order History** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

List paginated order history for the internal account linked to the API key, newest first. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when the user asks about past purchases, fulfillment, payouts, or delegates on their internal account. Read-only. Pair with `tronsave_internal_order_details` for a single order's full snapshot.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page index, 0-based. Omit for first page (default 0). (min 0) |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Orders per page. Default 10 when omitted. Typical range 1–100. (min 1) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | object[] | Orders on this page, newest first. |
| `total` | number | Total orders matching the query (for pagination). |

## tronsave_internal_order_details

**Internal Order Details** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Fetch full details for one internal-account order by order ID. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when monitoring fulfillment after `tronsave_internal_order_create`, or when the user asks for status on a specific order id. Read-only. FRESHNESS: order state changes within seconds as the market matches — re-read immediately before acting.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | yes | TronSave order ID (hex string), e.g. value returned in internal.order.create response data.orderId. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | TronSave order ID (hex string). |
| `requester` | string | TRON base58 requester address. |
| `receiver` | string | TRON base58 receiver address. |
| `resourceAmount` | number | Resource amount of order. |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | Resource type. |
| `remainAmount` | number | Remaining unfulfilled amount. |
| `orderType` | string | Order type (NORMAL \| FAST \| EXTEND). |
| `price` | number | Unit price in SUN. |
| `durationSec` | number | Delegated duration in seconds. |
| `status` | string | Order status. |
| `allowPartialFill` | boolean | Whether partial fill is allowed. |
| `payoutAmount` | number | Payout amount in SUN. |
| `fulfilledPercent` | number | 0 = pending, 1-99 = partial, 100 = fully matched. |

| `delegates` | object[] | Delegations fulfilling this order. |

## tronsave_internal_order_book

**Internal Market Order Book** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Return the current TronSave market depth/price tiers for ENERGY or BANDWIDTH via the api-key REST endpoint. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use before `tronsave_internal_order_create` or `tronsave_internal_order_estimate` when the user needs live prices or liquidity. Read-only. FRESHNESS: live market depth can change roughly every 3 seconds (one TRON block) — re-read immediately before placing an order.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | no | Optional TRON base58 address filter for the receiver. (TRON address) |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted. |
| `minDelegateAmount` | number | no | Minimum resource amount per offer level to include (resource units, not SUN). (min 0) |
| `durationSec` | integer | no | Delegation duration window in seconds for the quote. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | object[] | Order book entries sorted by price. |
| `slow` | number | SLOW price tier (SUN). |
| `medium` | number | MEDIUM price tier (SUN). |
| `fast` | number | FAST price tier (SUN). |
| `availableResource` | number | Available resource at the quoted tiers. |

## tronsave_internal_order_estimate

**Estimate TRX Cost Before Order** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Estimate the TRX cost and availability for a buy order before submitting it (api-key internal account). Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when the user wants a quote or price check; feed the result into `tronsave_internal_order_create`. Read-only. FRESHNESS: `unitPrice`/`estimateTrx` are live and can change roughly every 3 seconds — re-estimate immediately before creating the order.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted. |
| `resourceAmount` | number | yes | Amount of resource to purchase (resource units). |
| `receiver` | string | no | TRON base58 address that will receive the resource. (TRON address) |
| `requester` | string | no | TRON base58 requester; defaults to the API key account when omitted. (TRON address) |
| `durationSec` | integer | no | Delegation duration in seconds. Default 259200 (3 days) when omitted. |
| `unitPrice` | `FAST` \| `MEDIUM` \| `SLOW` \| number | no | Pricing: FAST \| MEDIUM \| SLOW strategy, or exact unit price in SUN per resource unit. Default MEDIUM when omitted. |
| `options` | object | no | Optional flags that affect matching behavior for the estimate. |
| `options.allowPartialFill` | boolean | no | Allow partial fill so the order can match partially. Default true when omitted. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `unitPrice` | number | Unit price in SUN. |
| `durationSec` | number | Delegated duration in seconds. |
| `estimateTrx` | number | Estimated TRX cost in SUN. |
| `availableResource` | number | Available resource amount. |

## tronsave_internal_order_create

**Create Energy or Bandwidth Order (Internal)** · auth: api key (login or header) · write

Place a new buy order for ENERGY or BANDWIDTH on TronSave, paid from the internal account balance. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Side effect: SPENDS internal TRX balance and creates a live order; not idempotent — each call places a new order. This is the api-key/internal path; for the signature-session market path use `tronsave_create_order`. Always derive `unitPrice` from the latest `tronsave_internal_order_estimate` (re-estimate immediately before submitting — quotes older than a few seconds may be stale and revert). Returns `{ orderId }`.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted. |
| `resourceAmount` | number | yes | Amount of resource to purchase (resource units). |
| `receiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address that will receive the resource. (TRON address) |
| `durationSec` | integer | no | Delegation duration in seconds. Default 259200 (3 days) when omitted. |
| `unitPrice` | `FAST` \| `MEDIUM` \| `SLOW` \| number | no | Pricing: FAST \| MEDIUM \| SLOW strategy, or exact unit price in SUN per resource unit. Default MEDIUM when omitted. |
| `sponsor` | string | no | Optional sponsor or referral code. |
| `options` | object | no | Optional execution guards and fill behavior. |
| `options.allowPartialFill` | boolean | no | Allow partial fill. Default true when omitted. |
| `options.onlyCreateWhenFulfilled` | boolean | no | Only create if the order can be 100% fulfilled. Default false when omitted. |
| `options.maxPriceAccepted` | number | no | Maximum unit price in SUN you accept. (min 0) |
| `options.preventDuplicateIncompleteOrders` | boolean | no | Skip if an identical pending order already exists. Default false when omitted. |
| `options.minResourceDelegateRequiredAmount` | number | no | Minimum resource amount per matching provider (resource units). (min 0) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | New extension order id (hex string). |

## tronsave_internal_extend_delegates

**List Extendable Delegations** · auth: api key (login or header) · read-only, idempotent

Return extendable delegations for a receiver plus an `extendData` payload for the extension flow. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use as STEP 1 before `tronsave_internal_create_extend_request` when the user wants to extend existing delegation time. Read-only; does not submit anything. FRESHNESS: pricing/availability change within seconds — run immediately before extending and pass the returned `extendData` unchanged.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `receiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address of the account that receives the delegated resource. (TRON address) |
| `extendTo` | integer | yes | Target end time as Unix epoch SECONDS (UTC) for the extended delegation, e.g. now + 86400 for one more day. Milliseconds are rejected by TronSave (INVALID_EXTEND_TIME). |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted. |
| `maxPriceAccepted` | number | no | Maximum unit price in SUN you are willing to pay for the extension. (min 0) |
| `requester` | string | no | TRON base58 requester; defaults to the API key account when omitted. (TRON address) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `extendOrderBook` | object[] | Order book for extend. |
| `totalDelegateAmount` | number | Total delegated resource amount. |
| `totalAvailableExtendAmount` | number | Total available amount to extend. |
| `totalEstimateTrx` | number | Total estimated TRX cost in SUN. |
| `isAbleToExtend` | boolean | Whether balance is sufficient to extend. |
| `yourBalance` | number | Current account balance in SUN. |
| `extendData` | object[] | Delegations to extend; pass unchanged into internal_create_extend_request `extendData`. |

## tronsave_internal_create_extend_request

**Submit Delegation Extension** · auth: api key (login or header) · write

Submit an extension request for existing delegated resources on TronSave via authenticated REST `POST /v2/extend-request`. Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Side effect: creates an extension order and may commit TRX from the internal account. `extendData` must follow the REST contract (see schema on each row). Get `extendData` from `tronsave_internal_extend_delegates` (STEP 1) and pass the rows unchanged. Do not copy rows from `tronsave_list_extendable_delegates` (GraphQL); that payload shape differs and is for market discovery only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `receiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address of the account that receives the delegated resource. (TRON address) |
| `extendData` | object[] | yes | Delegator-level rows for `POST /v2/extend-request`. Each row matches TronSave's REST extend contract (delegator, isExtend, extraAmount, extendTo in Unix seconds)—typically taken from `extendData` returned by `POST /v2/get-extendable-delegates` when called with the user's session, not from GraphQL `tronsave_list_extendable_delegates`. |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | New extension order id (hex string). |

## tronsave_get_sign_message

**Get Signature Message** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Step 1 of wallet login. Returns `{ message, timestamp }`: ask the user to sign `message` with their TRON wallet (TronWeb `signMessageV2`, TronLink, etc.), then call `tronsave_login` with `signature: "<signature>_<timestamp>"`. Signing the plain decimal `timestamp` text is also accepted. No auth needed; no side effects on the account.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | Hex-encoded nonce message to sign client-side with the user's TRON wallet. The signature must be produced over THIS exact message (case-sensitive). |
| `timestamp` | integer | Unix epoch seconds corresponding to `message`. Pair it with the wallet signature in `<signature>_<timestamp>` form when calling `tronsave_login` (signature mode). This endpoint is a convenience helper; clients may provide their own timestamp payload as well. |

## tronsave_login

**Login Session** · auth: public · write

Log in to TronSave for the rest of this MCP connection. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: `signature` = `<signature>_<timestamp>` produced by the user's wallet over the `message` from `tronsave_get_sign_message` (unlocks wallet tools; also loads the wallet's internal API key if it has one), or `apiKey` = raw TronSave internal API key (unlocks internal-account tools and `paymentMethod=internal`). The login is bound to the current `mcp-session-id` automatically — do not pass session ids in later tool arguments. Returns `{ sessionId, authMode, walletAddress?, hasInternalApiKey, expiresAt, unlocked }`. Signed timestamps older than the server limit (default 24h) are rejected with `SIGNATURE_EXPIRED`. Never ask the user for private keys or seed phrases.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string | no | Raw API key for internal-tools login. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `apiKey` or `signature`. |
| `signature` | string | no | Signature token in `signature_timestamp` format (timestamp is the signed message). Provide EXACTLY ONE of `apiKey` or `signature`. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | string | The MCP session (`mcp-session-id`) the login is bound to. MCP clients resend it automatically; never pass it as a tool argument. |
| `authMode` | `signature` \| `api-key` | Which credential type the session holds. |
| `walletAddress` | string | Wallet recovered from the signature (signature mode only). |
| `hasInternalApiKey` | boolean | Whether internal-account tools and `paymentMethod=internal` are usable in this session. |
| `expiresAt` | string | Session expiry (ISO-8601). |
| `unlocked` | string | Human-readable summary of the tool groups now available. |
| `warnings` | string[] | Non-fatal issues (e.g. internal API key could not be loaded). |

## tronsave_logout

**Logout** · auth: public · write, idempotent

Remove the TronSave login bound to this MCP connection (api-key or signature). Returns `{ loggedOut: true }`; idempotent. Header credentials configured on the client are not affected.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loggedOut` | boolean | Always true; the login bound to this MCP session was removed (idempotent). |

## tronsave_get_session_status

**Session Status** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Report the current authentication state without calling TronSave: `authMode` (none | api-key | signature), `source` (login | header), `walletAddress`, `hasInternalApiKey`, `expiresAt`, network, and which tool groups are available now. Call this first when unsure whether to log in, and after `SESSION_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_SESSION_TYPE` errors.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `authenticated` | boolean | Whether any credential is active for this request. |
| `authMode` | `none` \| `api-key` \| `signature` | `signature` unlocks wallet tools; `api-key` unlocks internal-account tools. |
| `source` | `none` \| `login` \| `header` \| `oauth` | `login` = `tronsave_login` session, `header` = static Authorization header, `oauth` = OAuth sign-in by the client app. |
| `network` | `mainnet` \| `testnet` | Network served by this endpoint. |
| `walletAddress` | string | Wallet of the signature identity, if any. |
| `hasInternalApiKey` | boolean | Whether an internal API key is available for api-key tools. |
| `expiresAt` | string | Login expiry for `source=login`. |
| `headerAuthError` | object | Present when header credentials were sent but rejected. |
| `availableNow` | string[] | Tool groups callable with the current auth. |

## tronsave_get_user_info

**User Information** · auth: wallet signature · read-only, idempotent

Read the current authenticated user's profile and linked TronSave internal account. Returns `{ caller, address, balance (SUN string), info, internalAccount }` — `info` carries referral/contact metadata and may be null; `internalAccount` is null when the wallet has not provisioned a TronSave internal balance yet. `internalAccount.apiKey` is masked. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only and idempotent. Use `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` for the auto-sell config or `tronsave_get_user_permissions` for permission flags when the full profile is unnecessary.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `caller` | string | TRON base58 address of the caller |
| `address` | string | TRON base58 address |
| `balance` | string | Amount in SUN, onchain balance of the address |
| `info` | object |  |
| `internalAccount` | object |  |

## tronsave_get_user_auto_setting

**User Auto Setting** · auth: wallet signature · read-only, idempotent

Read the current user's auto-sell configuration (`autoSettings`). Returns the full `autoSettings` object — call this before `tronsave_register_auto_sell` or `tronsave_update_auto_sell_setting` to avoid overwriting fields you do not intend to change. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only and idempotent.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `permitOperations` | object[] | Permission rows enabled for this user; null/empty when no automation has been configured. |
| `energy` | object | Energy auto-sell pool snapshot; null when energy automation is disabled. |
| `bandwidth` | object | Bandwidth auto-sell pool snapshot; null when bandwidth automation is disabled. |
| `reclaimOnlyTronSave` | boolean | Reclaim flag — when `true`, only TronSave-managed delegations are reclaimed automatically. |
| `vote` | boolean | Whether vote-related automation is enabled for the wallet. |
| `withdrawVote` | string | Withdraw-vote configuration as a backend-defined string; semantics from TronSave docs. |
| `suggestSell` | boolean | Whether suggest-sell UX hints are enabled. |

## tronsave_get_user_permissions

**User Permissions** · auth: wallet signature · read-only, idempotent

Read the enabled permission operations (`autoSettings.permitOperations`) for the authenticated user. Returns `{ permitOperations: string[] }` — use it before mutating auto-sell or auto-buy rules to confirm the action is allowed for the wallet. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only and idempotent.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `permitOperations` | object[] | Permission rows enabled for this user; defaults to `[]` when nothing is configured. |

## tronsave_estimate_buy_resource

**Estimate Buy Resource** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Quote price and availability for buying ENERGY or BANDWIDTH for a receiver address before placing an order. Returns `{ unitPrice (SUN/unit), durationSec, estimateTrx (total cost in SUN), availableResource, systemDepositAddress }` — map them to `tronsave_create_order` as `orderUnitPrice`, `orderDurationSec`, `paymentPaymentAmount`. Defaults: ENERGY, 100000 units (1000 for BANDWIDTH), 900 s. Read-only and safe to call repeatedly; no session is required, but backend rate limits apply. For order-book depth use `tronsave_list_order_books`; for the minimum unit price only use `tronsave_get_min_price`.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Resource type to buy. Default ENERGY. (default `"ENERGY"`) |
| `receiver` | string | no | TRON address that will receive the resource. Strongly recommended: quotes depend on it. (TRON address) |
| `buyResourceAmount` | integer | no | Resource units to buy. Default 100000 for ENERGY and 1000 for BANDWIDTH. |
| `unitPrice` | number | no | Desired unit price in SUN. Values below the market minimum are raised to the minimum. Omit for the MEDIUM market price. |
| `durationSec` | integer | no | Delegation duration in seconds. Default 900 (15 minutes). |
| `allowPartialFill` | boolean | no | Allow partial fill of the order. |
| `minResourceDelegateRequiredAmount` | number | no | Minimum resource amount per matching provider. (min 0) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `systemDepositAddress` | string | TronSave deposit address; destination of the signed TRX transfer for `paymentMethod=onchain`. |
| `unitPrice` | number | Quoted unit price in SUN per resource unit → `orderUnitPrice`. |
| `durationSec` | number | Delegation duration in seconds → `orderDurationSec`. |
| `estimateTrx` | number | Estimated total cost in SUN (despite the name; TRX = value / 1e6) → `paymentPaymentAmount`. |
| `availableResource` | number | Resource units currently available at this price; if lower than requested, the order may fill partially. |

## tronsave_get_order

**Order Detail** · auth: wallet signature · read-only, idempotent

Read one order by `id` and return its full snapshot for NORMAL, FAST, or EXTEND order types. Use this as the source of truth before `tronsave_update_order`, `tronsave_sell_order_manual`, or `tronsave_cancel_order` to avoid acting on stale state. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only and idempotent.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Target order id (`MObjectId`) to inspect. Use this to confirm current status/price before update, sell, or cancel actions. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | object |  |

## tronsave_list_orders

**List Orders** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Query the market order list with paging (`offset`, `limit` ≤ 10). Returns `{ orders: [{ id, requester?.address, receiver.address, resourceType, resourceAmount, remainAmount, durationSec, unitPrice (SUN), isOwner, isMatching, apy, createdAt, typeOrder (NORMAL|FAST|EXTEND) }] }`. `status`: `ACTIVE` = still matching, `COMPLETED` = no longer matching. Set `isOnlyMyOrder=true` (requires a wallet signature identity) to list orders requested by the caller's wallet. Use `tronsave_get_order` with an `id` for one snapshot before mutating an order.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | integer | no | Zero-based row offset for page N (skip first `offset` matches). Omit when starting from the first page. (min 0, max 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum rows to return in one call. Prefer modest limits to avoid huge payloads; page with `offset`. (min 1, max 10) |
| `status` | `ACTIVE` \| `COMPLETED` | no | Lifecycle filter: `ACTIVE` = still matching/open, `COMPLETED` = no longer matching. Omit for both. |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Restrict to `ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH` orders; omit for both. |
| `isOnlyMyOrder` | boolean | no | When `true`, only orders requested by the wallet of the current signature identity (signature login or `Signature` header). Api-key-only sessions cannot use this filter. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orders` | object[] | Matching orders for this page; may be large—use pagination inputs to chunk. |

## tronsave_list_order_books

**Order Book** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Read market depth buckets for `ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH`. Returns price buckets `{ min, max, value }` optionally scoped by viewer address, minimum delegate amount, and duration. No login required; read-only and idempotent. Use this to estimate market ranges before create/update decisions; pair with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for quote-style buy estimation and `tronsave_get_order` for one concrete order.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | no | Optional viewer/requester wallet context. (TRON address) |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | Order-book side to query (`ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH`). |
| `minDelegateAmount` | number | no | Optional minimum delegate amount floor for bucket filtering. |
| `durationSec` | number | no | Optional delegation duration filter in seconds. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orderBook` | object[] |  |

## tronsave_get_min_price

**Get Minimum Unit Price** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

Quote the minimum unit price for a buy. Returns `{ minPrice }` (SUN per resource unit; per day when `durationSec` >= 86400) from GraphQL `market.estimateMinPrice` for the given `resourceType`, `buyAmount`, and `durationSec`. Optional `address` scopes context when the API supports it. No login required. Read-only and idempotent. Pair with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for full buy quotes and `tronsave_list_order_books` for depth buckets.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | no | Optional TRON base58 address (`TronAddress`). When omitted, the server uses anonymous/global market context. (TRON address) |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | no | Market leg: `ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH`. Default ENERGY (default `"ENERGY"`) |
| `buyAmount` | number | no | Resource amount to price (same units as order book / delegate amounts for that resource type). Default 100000 for ENERGY and 1000 for BANDWIDTH |
| `durationSec` | number | no | Delegation window in seconds; must match the duration you plan to use on a real order for comparable quotes. Default 15 minutes (default `900`) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `minPrice` | number | Estimated minimum unit price in SUN for the given `resourceType`, `buyAmount`, and `durationSec`; align with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` and order `unitPrice` conventions (same as GraphQL `market.estimateMinPrice`). |

## tronsave_list_extendable_delegates

**Extendable Delegates** · auth: public · read-only, idempotent

List extendable delegate candidates for a `receiver` and `resourceType` (ENERGY|BANDWIDTH). Optional `suggestData` scores an extend-and-buy scenario for planning purposes. Read-only; does NOT create orders or change on-chain state. No login required. NOTE: this is GraphQL market data for discovery only. To actually submit an extension, use `tronsave_internal_create_extend_request` with `extendData` from the authenticated REST `POST /v2/get-extendable-delegates` (payload shape differs from this GraphQL response).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requester` | string | no | Optional TRON base58 address of the viewing/requesting party. When an MCP session is active, the server may still derive identity from auth headers; use this when the API expects an explicit requester string distinct from the receiver. |
| `receiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address (typically starts with `T`) that currently receives or will receive the delegated resource. This is the primary filter: the response describes delegates relevant to extending that account's delegation. (TRON address) |
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | Which resource market leg to query: `ENERGY` for contract execution headroom, `BANDWIDTH` for transaction bandwidth. Must match how you plan to extend or buy. |
| `suggestData` | object | no | Optional nested scenario for extend-and-buy suggestion scoring. If omitted, the query returns delegate rows without that hypothetical. If provided, supply all four fields together; partial objects are invalid for typical GraphQL input shapes. |
| `suggestData.extendTo` | number | yes | Target end time for the extended delegation window, as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC); align with TronSave REST extend flows when comparing suggest windows. |
| `suggestData.extraBuyAmount` | number | yes | Hypothetical extra ENERGY or BANDWIDTH units to buy beyond simple extension; units match `resourceType`, not SUN. |
| `suggestData.extendAmount` | number | yes | Hypothetical amount of existing delegation to extend (resource units matching `resourceType`). |
| `suggestData.maxPrice` | number | yes | Maximum unit price in SUN the user is willing to pay for the suggested extend/buy path; used for server-side scoring, not a live order placement by itself. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `extendableDelegates` | object | Null when the market has no payload or GraphQL returned no branch; check tool-level errors for hard failures. |

## tronsave_create_order

**Create Order** · auth: public · write

Create a buy order for ENERGY/BANDWIDTH delegated to `orderReceiver`. SPENDS FUNDS — confirm the plan with the user first. Inputs: `orderResourceType`, `orderReceiver`, `orderUnitPrice` (SUN, not TRX), `orderDurationSec`, `orderResourceAmount`, `paymentPaymentAmount` (SUN), and `paymentMethod`: `internal` — debits the TronSave internal balance (needs an api-key login/header or a signature login whose wallet has an internal account); `onchain` — no login needed, but `paymentSignedTx` must be the user's wallet-signed TRX transfer to `systemDepositAddress`. Take price/amount/duration values from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. Returns `{ success, message, code, data.orderId }` — check `success`; verify with `tronsave_get_order` or `tronsave_list_orders`. Not idempotent: on a timeout, verify before retrying to avoid duplicate orders.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderResourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | Resource to buy: ENERGY (smart contracts) or BANDWIDTH (transactions). Must match `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. |
| `orderReceiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address (starts with T) that receives delegated resource. Same as `receiver` passed to `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. (TRON address) |
| `orderUnitPrice` | number | yes | Unit price in SUN per resource unit (NOT TRX). Use `unitPrice` from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for the same receiver, amount, and duration. |
| `orderDurationSec` | integer | yes | Delegation duration in seconds. Must match the `durationSec` used in `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. |
| `orderResourceAmount` | integer | yes | Amount of ENERGY or BANDWIDTH units to purchase. Same as `buyResourceAmount` in estimate when applicable. |
| `paymentMethod` | `onchain` \| `internal` | yes | Payment method for this order: `onchain` (wallet signed tx) or `internal` (internal balance). |
| `paymentPaymentAmount` | number | yes | Total payment in SUN (1 TRX = 1e6 SUN). Use `estimateTrx` (SUN) from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`. (min 0) |
| `paymentSignedTx` | object | no | Required when `paymentMethod=onchain`: the user's wallet-signed TRX transfer of `paymentPaymentAmount` SUN to `systemDepositAddress` (from `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`), TronWeb shape `{ txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, signature[] }`. Must be produced client-side by the user's wallet; never fabricate or hand-edit. |
| `paymentSignedTx.txID` | string | yes | Transaction hash (64 hex chars, lowercase, no `0x` prefix). (hex) |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data` | object | yes | Raw transaction body produced by TronWeb (`raw_data`). |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data.contract` | object[] | yes | At least one TRON contract entry; shape varies by contract type. |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data.ref_block_bytes` | string | yes | Reference block bytes (hex). |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data.ref_block_hash` | string | yes | Reference block hash (hex). |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data.expiration` | integer | yes | Tx expiration (Unix epoch ms). |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data.timestamp` | integer | yes | Tx timestamp (Unix epoch ms). |
| `paymentSignedTx.raw_data_hex` | string | yes | Hex-encoded `raw_data` body. (hex) |
| `paymentSignedTx.signature` | string[] | yes | Wallet signatures over `raw_data_hex`; usually a single hex string (130 chars for 65-byte secp256k1). |
| `paymentSignedTx.visible` | boolean | no | Whether addresses inside `raw_data.contract` are base58 (`true`) vs hex (`false`). |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `data` | object |  |

## tronsave_sell_order_manual

**Sell Order Manual** · auth: wallet signature · write, destructive

Manually execute seller-side fulfillment of an existing order with a wallet `signedTx`. Returns `{ success, message, code, delegatedId }`. Side effect: broadcasts a market/delegation transaction and may consume balances/resources; not idempotent — each call re-executes. Requires a wallet signature identity. Use only when explicit manual sell is intended; call `tronsave_get_order` first to verify order state before signing.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | yes | Target order id (`MObjectId`) to manually fulfill. Should be an order eligible for seller-side manual execution. |
| `signedTx` | object | yes | Required wallet-signed transaction payload (TronWeb shape: `{ txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, signature[] }`). Must come from client-side signing; never fabricate. |
| `signedTx.txID` | string | yes | Transaction hash (64 hex chars, lowercase, no `0x` prefix). (hex) |
| `signedTx.raw_data` | object | yes | Raw transaction body produced by TronWeb (`raw_data`). |
| `signedTx.raw_data.contract` | object[] | yes | At least one TRON contract entry; shape varies by contract type. |
| `signedTx.raw_data.ref_block_bytes` | string | yes | Reference block bytes (hex). |
| `signedTx.raw_data.ref_block_hash` | string | yes | Reference block hash (hex). |
| `signedTx.raw_data.expiration` | integer | yes | Tx expiration (Unix epoch ms). |
| `signedTx.raw_data.timestamp` | integer | yes | Tx timestamp (Unix epoch ms). |
| `signedTx.raw_data_hex` | string | yes | Hex-encoded `raw_data` body. (hex) |
| `signedTx.signature` | string[] | yes | Wallet signatures over `raw_data_hex`; usually a single hex string (130 chars for 65-byte secp256k1). |
| `signedTx.visible` | boolean | no | Whether addresses inside `raw_data.contract` are base58 (`true`) vs hex (`false`). |
| `paymentAddress` | string | no | Optional payout/payment address override when settlement flow requires it. (TRON address) |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `delegatedId` | string | On-chain delegate id created by the manual sell when the underlying transaction is confirmed; null until confirmation lands. |

## tronsave_cancel_order

**Cancel Order** · auth: wallet signature · write, destructive, idempotent

Cancel an open order by `orderId`. Returns `{ success, message, code }`. Side effect: marks the order non-matchable and refunds locked balance per backend rules; effectively destructive on the live order. Idempotent — cancelling an already-cancelled order is a no-op success. Fails for fulfilled orders or unauthorized callers. Requires a wallet signature identity (the order's owner). Verify state with `tronsave_get_order` first; prefer `tronsave_update_order` when only price/receiver should change.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | yes | Target order id (`MObjectId`) to cancel. Must be an active order owned/authorized by the current session; already-fulfilled or already-cancelled orders are expected to fail. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |

## tronsave_update_order

**Update Order** · auth: wallet signature · write

Update an open order by `orderId` with partial fields (`receiver`, `newPrice`). Returns `{ success, message, code }`. Side effect: overwrites live order parameters; not idempotent — each call with a different `newPrice` produces a new state. Requires a wallet signature identity (the order's owner). Prefer this over cancel+recreate when only price/receiver should change. Verify state with `tronsave_get_order` first; fails for already-fulfilled, already-cancelled, or non-editable orders.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | string | yes | Target order id (`MObjectId`) to update. Order must still be open and editable. |
| `receiver` | string | no | Optional replacement receiver TRON address. (TRON address) |
| `newPrice` | number | no | Optional replacement unit price in SUN per resource unit. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |

Use for FIRST-TIME setup only; for subsequent edits use `tronsave_update_auto_sell_setting`, and always read the current state with `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` first to avoid overwriting unknown fields. | `poolSetting.energy.minPrice` | number | no | Minimum unit price accepted for auto matches. |

| `poolSetting.bandwidth` | object | no |  |

| `poolSetting.bandwidth.maxDelegateDurationSec` | integer | no | Upper bound delegation duration (seconds). |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.minDelegateDurationSec` | integer | no | Lower bound delegation duration (seconds). |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.maintainUnDelegate` | number | no | Buffer of undelegated resource the seller keeps. |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.minDelegateAmount` | number | no | Minimum per-delegation resource amount. |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.minPrice` | number | no | Minimum unit price accepted for auto matches. |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.profitShare` | integer | no | Profit share percentage for this resource leg. |
| `poolSetting.reclaim` | `ALL` \| `ONLY_TRONSAVE` | no | Reclaim behaviour: ALL resources vs ONLY_TRONSAVE-managed delegations. |

| `addOnFeature.vote` | boolean | no | Enable vote-related automation when supported. |
| `addOnFeature.withdrawVote` | number | no | GraphQL Float input for withdraw-vote configuration. |
| `addOnFeature.stake` | object | no | Optional auto-stake policy. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.minAmount` | number | yes | Minimum TRX (sun semantics per API) for auto-stake trigger. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.remainBalance` | number | yes | TRX balance floor to preserve after staking. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.resourceStake` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | Whether auto-stake targets ENERGY or BANDWIDTH. |
| `addOnFeature.suggestSell` | boolean | no | Enable suggest-sell UX hints. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `data` | string | Opaque server-defined payload (tx id, setting id, or status text). Treat as identifier-or-message; rely on `message` for human routing. |

| `poolSetting.bandwidth.minPrice` | number | no | Minimum unit price accepted for auto matches. |
| `poolSetting.bandwidth.profitShare` | integer | no | Profit share percentage for this resource leg. |
| `poolSetting.reclaim` | `ALL` \| `ONLY_TRONSAVE` | no | Reclaim behaviour: ALL resources vs ONLY_TRONSAVE-managed delegations. |
| `addOnFeature` | object | no |  |
| `addOnFeature.vote` | boolean | no | Enable vote-related automation when supported. |
| `addOnFeature.withdrawVote` | number | no | GraphQL Float input for withdraw-vote configuration. |
| `addOnFeature.stake` | object | no | Optional auto-stake policy. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.minAmount` | number | yes | Minimum TRX (sun semantics per API) for auto-stake trigger. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.remainBalance` | number | yes | TRX balance floor to preserve after staking. |
| `addOnFeature.stake.resourceStake` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | Whether auto-stake targets ENERGY or BANDWIDTH. |
| `addOnFeature.suggestSell` | boolean | no | Enable suggest-sell UX hints. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `data` | string | Opaque server-defined payload (tx id, setting id, or status text). Treat as identifier-or-message; rely on `message` for human routing. |

## tronsave_generate_api_key

**Generate API Key** · auth: wallet signature · write, destructive

Generate a new internal API key credential for the current user. Returns `data` containing the issued key — show it to the user once and tell them to store it securely; do not repeat it in later messages. Side effect: issues secret material; not idempotent — each call mints a fresh key and may invalidate the previous one per backend policy. Requires a wallet signature identity. Sensitive output — never log raw keys; unauthorized sessions or policy checks may reject issuance.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `data` | string | For `generateApiKey`: the freshly issued internal API key — treat as SECRET, store securely. For `revokeApiKey`: server-defined confirmation string (no key material). |

## tronsave_revoke_api_key

**Revoke API Key** · auth: wallet signature · write, destructive, idempotent

Revoke the caller's current internal API key. Side effect: any future request using the previous key is rejected. Existing in-flight sessions cached by the server may continue serving until their TTL expires — treat the effect as 'best-effort immediate' rather than guaranteed instantaneous cutoff. Idempotent — revoking an already-revoked key returns success. Requires a wallet signature identity. Call `tronsave_generate_api_key` afterwards to mint a replacement when continued internal access is needed.

**Input**

_No arguments._

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |
| `data` | string | For `generateApiKey`: the freshly issued internal API key — treat as SECRET, store securely. For `revokeApiKey`: server-defined confirmation string (no key material). |

## tronsave_delete_auto_buy_setting

**Delete Auto Buy Setting** · auth: wallet signature · write, destructive, idempotent

Permanently delete one auto-buy rule by `id` (`MObjectId`). Side effect: stops all future executions matching that rule; the rule cannot be restored. Idempotent — deleting a non-existent or already-removed id returns success. Requires a wallet signature identity. Use `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` to list current rules first; prefer disabling/updating instead when reversibility is desired.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `id` | string | yes | Auto-buy setting id (`MObjectId`) to delete. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | integer | GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing. |
| `success` | boolean | Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`. |
| `message` | string | Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure. |

## tronsave_create_auto_buy_setting

**Create Auto-Buy Rule** · auth: wallet signature · write

Create a rule that automatically buys `resourceAmount` for `receiver` whenever its remaining resource falls below `thresholdResourceAmount`, paying up to `unitPrice` SUN per unit from the TronSave internal balance. Side effect: SPENDS internal TRX every time the rule fires until a budget/order limit or `endActiveAt` stops it; not idempotent (each call adds a rule). Confirm receiver, amounts, price cap and limits with the user first; prefer setting `limitBudgetInSun`. Requires a wallet signature identity.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes | ENERGY or BANDWIDTH. |
| `receiver` | string | yes | TRON base58 address that receives each delegation. (TRON address) |
| `unitPrice` | string | yes | Maximum unit price in SUN, as a decimal string. |
| `durationSec` | number | yes | Delegation duration of each purchase, in seconds. |
| `resourceAmount` | number | yes | Resource units bought each time the rule fires. |
| `thresholdResourceAmount` | number | yes | Rule fires when the receiver's remaining resource drops below this many units (TronSave requires at least 100000). (min 0) |
| `limitBudgetInSun` | string | no | Optional total budget cap in SUN (decimal string); must be greater than 10000000 (10 TRX). |
| `limitInOrderCount` | integer | no | Optional cap on the number of orders. |
| `startActiveAt` | integer | no | Optional Unix time in seconds when the rule starts. |
| `endActiveAt` | integer | no | Optional Unix time in seconds when the rule stops. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | number |  |
| `success` | boolean |  |
| `message` | string |  |

| `endActiveAt` | integer | no | Optional Unix time in seconds when the rule stops. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

## tronsave_bulk_create_internal_orders

**Bulk Buy For Many Receivers** · auth: wallet signature · write

Buy the SAME amount of ENERGY or BANDWIDTH for several receiver addresses in one call, paid from the TronSave internal balance; returns one order id per receiver. Side effect: SPENDS `paymentAmount` SUN of the internal balance; not idempotent (a repeat buys again). Estimate one receiver with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` first and show the user receivers, amount and total cost before calling. Requires a wallet signature identity.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resourceType` | `ENERGY` \| `BANDWIDTH` | yes |  |
| `receivers` | string[] | yes | Receiver addresses (1 to 50). |
| `unitPrice` | number | yes | Unit price in SUN per resource unit, per receiver. |
| `durationSec` | number | yes | Delegation duration in seconds. |
| `resourceAmount` | number | yes | Resource units bought for EACH receiver. |
| `paymentAmount` | number | yes | Total payment in SUN for the whole batch. Must equal the total payout (about unitPrice x resourceAmount x receivers x durationSec / 86400) within 2%; a mismatch is rejected with the expected total. |
| `sponsor` | string | no | Optional sponsor or referral code. |

**Output (`structuredContent`)**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | number |  |
| `success` | boolean |  |
| `message` | string |  |
| `data` | string[] |  |
